add.issue.name: Empty states in the ticket panel act as their section's control

edit.description.md:
"No description", "No tags", "No assignees" and "No attachments — drop an image here" are dead text under the header control. Make them clickable, doing exactly what the section's control does.

- `Empty` gains optional `onActivate` + `testId`: renders a full-width `<button>`, menu-row hover/focus background, pointer cursor. Without it: inert text as today.
- Description → Edit (lane/board panels too); tags, assignees → their + (issue and bulk); attachments → file picker when `canUpload`, drop still works.
- Readonly / time travel: no `onActivate`.
- No new copy. Out of scope: comments, code, stats empties.
- e2e-gui: click opens each control, file chooser, readonly inert, Tab+Enter.

Plan from jola via claude/reviewer; PR goes to claude/reviewer, merge only on jola's approval.

add.issue.comment.md: PR #493. Deviations: bulk has no +, so its empties focus the always-shown add input. Readonly is tested offline (same flag as a scrub); a closed ticket isn't readonly in the GUI.
